items.title: Satoshi Nakamoto publishes the Bitcoin white paper
items.detail: A nine-page proposal for a peer-to-peer electronic cash system.

items.title: The Bitcoin network starts: the first block is mined
10,000 BTC buy two pizzas, the first known purchase with bitcoin
items.detail: A programmer pays another forum user for pizza delivery.

items.title: Mt. Gox opens as a bitcoin exchange
A bug creates 184 billion bitcoins in one transaction; a fix is released
items.detail: The invalid block is wiped out by a patched version of the software.

items.title: Satoshi Nakamoto makes a final public post on the Bitcoin forum
Bitcoin reaches parity with the US dollar: $1 per BTC
Gawker exposes Silk Road, a hidden marketplace that accepts only bitcoin
Bitcoin surges above $30 as interest explodes
items.detail: The price has multiplied several times over in a few weeks.

items.title: Mt. Gox is hacked: stolen coins flood the market and its price briefly hits one cent
S&P downgrades the United States' credit rating for the first time
First halving: the reward for each block drops from 50 to 25 bitcoins
A software bug splits the blockchain; Mt. Gox halts deposits until miners roll back
Cyprus agrees a bailout that taxes bank deposits; savers panic
items.detail: Bitcoin is discussed as a place to move money outside the banking system.

items.title: US regulator FinCEN issues guidance: bitcoin exchangers must register as money transmitters
Bitcoin spikes to about $266, then halves within hours as exchanges buckle under demand
US authorities seize Mt. Gox accounts over its registration with FinCEN
A US federal judge rules bitcoin is "a currency or form of money"
FBI shuts down Silk Road and arrests its alleged founder; about 26,000 BTC are seized
The world's first bitcoin ATM opens in Vancouver
A US Senate committee holds a hearing on virtual currencies
Bitcoin passes $1,000 for the first time
China's central bank bars financial institutions from handling bitcoin
Mt. Gox halts bitcoin withdrawals, citing a technical problem
Mt. Gox stops trading and its website goes offline
Mt. Gox files for bankruptcy protection in Tokyo, reporting hundreds of thousands of bitcoins missing
The IRS rules that bitcoin is property, not currency, for US tax purposes
US Marshals auction nearly 30,000 bitcoins seized from Silk Road
New York proposes the "BitLicense" for bitcoin businesses
Microsoft begins accepting bitcoin for Xbox and Windows purchases
Bitstamp suspends trading after about 19,000 BTC are stolen
Coinbase raises $75 million, the biggest funding round yet for a bitcoin company
Silk Road founder Ross Ulbricht is found guilty on all seven counts
New York finalizes its BitLicense rules
The CFTC declares bitcoin a commodity
Developer Mike Hearn quits, declaring the bitcoin experiment a failure as the block-size fight boils over
Ethereum's "DAO" investment fund is drained of roughly $50 million in a hack
Britain votes to leave the European Union; markets lurch
Second halving: the block reward drops to 12.5 bitcoins
Bitfinex is hacked: almost 120,000 BTC are stolen
India withdraws its two largest banknotes overnight
Donald Trump wins the US presidential election
Bitcoin tops $1,000 again, for the first time in three years
The SEC rejects the Winklevoss bitcoin ETF proposal
Japan's law recognizing bitcoin as a legal payment method takes effect
Bitcoin crosses $2,000 for the first time
Bitcoin splits: Bitcoin Cash forks off with larger blocks
SegWit activates on the Bitcoin network
China bans initial coin offerings
JPMorgan chief Jamie Dimon calls bitcoin "a fraud"
Bitcoin breaks $5,000 for the first time
The planned SegWit2x hard fork is cancelled
Bitcoin passes $10,000 for the first time
Cboe launches bitcoin futures: the first on a regulated US exchange
Bitcoin sets a new all-time record near $19,900 as CME launches its own futures
Japan's Coincheck loses about $530 million of NEM tokens in a hack
Facebook bans cryptocurrency advertising
Bitcoin sinks below $7,000, down by half in 16 days
Bitcoin slides to roughly $3,200, more than 80% below its record
Binance is hacked: about 7,000 BTC are stolen
Facebook unveils Libra, a global digital currency project
"Black Thursday": bitcoin plunges about 40% in a day as COVID-19 panic grips global markets
The Federal Reserve cuts rates to near zero in an emergency move
Third halving: the block reward drops to 6.25 bitcoins
MicroStrategy buys $250 million of bitcoin as a treasury reserve
PayPal will let US users buy, hold and sell bitcoin
Bitcoin passes $20,000 for the first time, a new record
Bitcoin tops $40,000 as institutional buying gathers pace
Tesla discloses a $1.5 billion bitcoin purchase
Bitcoin crosses $50,000
Bitcoin's total value tops $1 trillion for the first time
Coinbase goes public as bitcoin sets a record near $64,800
Tesla stops accepting bitcoin, citing the energy used to mine it
Bitcoin plunges as much as 30% in a day on a China crackdown and forced liquidations
El Salvador's congress passes a law making bitcoin legal tender
El Salvador becomes the first country to adopt bitcoin as legal tender
China's central bank declares all cryptocurrency transactions illegal
The first US bitcoin futures ETF, ProShares BITO, begins trading
Bitcoin sets a new all-time record near $69,000
The Taproot upgrade activates on the Bitcoin network
Russia invades Ukraine; global markets tumble
The Federal Reserve raises interest rates for the first time since 2018
TerraUSD, a leading stablecoin, slips below its $1 peg
Terra's LUNA collapses and the crypto market is rocked
Celsius Network freezes customer withdrawals
Bitcoin falls below $18,000, under its 2017 record for the first time since 2020
Crypto hedge fund Three Arrows Capital is ordered into liquidation
Ethereum completes "the Merge", switching to proof of stake
A CoinDesk report raises questions about the balance sheet of FTX-linked Alameda Research
Binance agrees to buy rival exchange FTX amid a run on withdrawals
Binance walks away from the FTX deal
FTX files for bankruptcy
Silicon Valley Bank collapses, the largest US bank failure since 2008
Signature Bank is closed; regulators guarantee depositors
The SEC sues Binance
The SEC sues Coinbase
BlackRock files for a spot bitcoin ETF
A US appeals court rules for Grayscale against the SEC over a bitcoin ETF
Binance founder Changpeng Zhao pleads guilty; Binance agrees to a $4.3 billion settlement
The SEC approves spot bitcoin ETFs
Bitcoin tops $70,000 for the first time
Bitcoin sets a new all-time record near $73,700 as ETFs draw record inflows
Fourth halving: the block reward drops to 3.125 bitcoins
The SEC approves spot Ether ETFs
A global market rout drags bitcoin below $50,000
